## Bio


I am a Ph.D. candidate in Genetics, Genomics, and Bioinformatics in Jeremy Day’s lab at the University of Alabama at Birmingham. I’m passionate about studying the DNA sequences that orchestrate the genome's informational output in response to environmental context, how this output reshapes the environment in turn, and how these systems become dysregulated in disease. To study these mechanisms, I integrate multimodal genomics data using computational modeling.
